drafts.draft_en:
When an AI-generated ad makes a claim legal never approved, it doesn't ship.

Aubric blocks it before publish, tells you exactly which line broke which rule, and suggests the fix.

Supply-chain security for code is table stakes now. Creative is next.
drafts.video_tip: 15s vertical screen capture: an ad heads to 'Publish', the verdict flips to BLOCK, then zoom on the flagged line with the rule it broke and the suggested rewrite. End on the green APPROVE after the fix.

drafts.draft_en:
How to get your ad account banned:

Let AI write 200 variants and check none of them before they go live.
drafts.video_tip: 6-8s vertical, two text cards on black: the setup line, then the punchline with a red 'ACCOUNT RESTRICTED' banner sliding in. Plain text also works; one-liners keep winning.

drafts.draft_en:
Observation: the more ads AI can generate, the more valuable a single 'no' becomes.

Creating creative is basically free now. Knowing which piece shouldn't ship is the scarce skill.
drafts.video_tip: 10s vertical: a fast scroll of dozens of generated ads, then everything freezes and one ad gets a red BLOCK stamp. Caption the last frame with the second line.
